data.overview: In London's crowded riverside quarter, a delicate young woman endures the cruelty of her boxer father until a kind immigrant offers her a quiet refuge. Their fragile friendship blossoms in a world that gives tenderness little room to survive.
data.tagline: A fragile kindness in a hard-edged world.
data.title: Blossoms in the Fog
